biological_expectation: A long-protection reference should reduce 2023-2025 true and reported cases when waning has accumulated susceptible vaccinated cohorts.
interpretation_rule: Read as a waning-protection scenario contrast under the fitted immune-state model; it is not separable from programme history without the stated model assumptions.

biological_expectation: Restoring booster reach should lower infections where adolescent or adult programme gaps leave waned vaccinated states more susceptible.
interpretation_rule: Read together with the waning scenario because booster reach and waning jointly define the programme-protection landscape.

biological_expectation: Restoring the 2021-2024 normal exposure-boosting and background-recharge path should reduce the 2025 effective susceptible stock when reduced circulation interrupted natural immunity.
interpretation_rule: This single-switch scenario changes only exposure-driven boosting and background exposure recharge while keeping fitted infection pressure, vaccine waning, routine flow and reporting in place. It is the primary Model 2C readout for natural-immunity interruption.

biological_expectation: Restoring infection-pressure contact suppression alone should change infections when reduced circulation directly suppressed transmission.
interpretation_rule: This single-switch scenario changes infection contact suppression while holding exposure boosting, vaccine waning, routine flow and reporting on the fitted path.

biological_expectation: Restoring birth-cohort DTP1 initiation and DTP3 completion to at least the recent pre-pandemic baseline should reduce the fitted 2025 delayed-dose debt when coverage disruption or DTP1-to-DTP3 dropout created susceptible cohorts.
interpretation_rule: This replay separates DTP1 initiation, partial vaccine-derived protection and DTP3 completion into full vaccine-derived protection, and adds explicit routine delay debt. The primary readout is cohort-susceptibility debt rather than an all-age reported-case fraction.

biological_expectation: Using reference monthly births and age-population denominators should change cases when birth-cohort size or age structure modifies the susceptible pool.
interpretation_rule: Demography is a reference-path modifier. Negative or small differences are valid model outputs and should be interpreted as boundary information.

literature_mechanism: pathogen pressure, seeding and residual contact recovery
biological_expectation: Neutralizing post-2023 context terms should lower fitted cases when residual pressure or seeding is needed to match timing and peaks.
interpretation_rule: This is a context and model-criticism audit, not a named susceptibility mechanism. It should qualify the scenario claims rather than be folded into them.

biological_expectation: Setting post-2023 reporting visibility to neutral should change reported cases without changing true or symptomatic infections.
interpretation_rule: This scenario is a visibility audit for reported cases only and should not be used as a transmission-mechanism statement.
